facts.fact: Vision224 reports ANSSI experts and technical agencies are mobilised to deploy a public-key infrastructure and secure electronic signature for the administration, to replace scanned signature copies, as the digital economy ministry's secretary general told a meeting.

systems.system: ANSSI (Agence nationale de la securite des systemes d'information)

GIN.note: ANSSI is named only as deploying the PKI; no creation, incident or alert stated.
